messages:
jenna: Hey team — pleased to announce Amira Patel is joining Redwood Inference as Senior Director, Product Ops. Start date Apr 18. She'll own product rollout ops, platform metrics, and program-led onboarding. Amira, mind sharing a 2-line intro? :tada:
Amira Patel: Hi all! Super excited to join Redwood. I was most recently Head of Product Ops at Nimbus AI — ran rollout playbooks, led onboarding for several cross-functional launches, and partnered closely with eng and CS to reduce time-to-value. My priorities: repeatable rollouts, stronger launch observability, and scalable onboarding. Happy to meet folks one-on-one. :)
Devon Lee: Welcome Amira! Big win. Quick note on ramp: 1) review active rollouts (email coming), 2) sync with platform + eng leadership Wed 9am, 3) shadow the caching-v2 rollout next week. You’ll be on the product all-hands on Apr 22.
Olivia (Talent): Welcome!! Onboarding checklist here: https://okta.redwood/onboard/amira — please update laptop prefs, badge, and payroll details. Looping in Samir as tech buddy. :rocket:
Samir Khan: Welcome Amira — excited to work together. I’ll run you through the runtime dashboards and the observability playbook. Put Mon 10am on your calendar for a quick sync.
hr-bot: Onboarding tasks updated: laptop order placed, badge request sent, payroll invite delivered.
maria (CS): :tada: welcome! FYI we have a customer readout on Apr 25 — product ops support on rollout notes would be great.
jenna: Quick org note — Amira reports to Devon. We’re also opening a Product Ops Program Manager role to backfill execution work; posting this week. If you have referrals ping Olivia.
Amira Patel: Thanks everyone — excited to get started. I’ll share a 30/60/90 plan by my first day and would love shadow slots for caching-v2 and the Apr 25 readout.
Devon Lee: Amazing — everyone please add Amira to relevant docs and calendars. :thumbsup:
